current_activity: most of the division arrives in the Remagen bridgehead to take over its southern and south-eastern parts
notes: Event date: 12 March 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 11 p. 226: on 12 March, with the arrival of most of the 99th Infantry Division in the bridgehead to take over the southern and southeastern portions of the periphery, Millikin ordered all units shifted back to their parent divisions). Event definition: the division joins III Corps in the Remagen bridgehead; the CMH table lists III Corps and First Army from 9 March.
